recipe.visualDefinition: A crude, hand-drawn black ink illustration on a textured white napkin featuring five stick figures standing in a row, enclosed within a thick-bordered rectangular frame with text boxes at the top and bottom.
coreVisualRelationships: Stick figures centered within a large middle panel
Text boxes vertically stacked above and below the central image
Heavy, bleeding ink lines contrasting against fibrous paper texture

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Five stick figures occupy the central 60% of the frame, arranged horizontally.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The thick, double-lined rectangular border that contains all elements.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Top text box down to the central figures, ending at the bottom text box.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: High negative space within the panels, emphasizing the starkness of the ink strokes.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black ink for all outlines and text
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High contrast, zero saturation monochromatic scheme.

letterConstructionRules: Variable stroke width due to ink bleed
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters like 'S' and 'G' have rounded, simplified curves
Horizontal bars on 'E' and 'A' are slightly uneven
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Consistent hand-drawn style across all text elements for a unified 'sketchbook' look.

candidateDirections.reason: Mimics the bleed and weight of the original lettering
Captures the organic, imperfect baseline and character width

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-resolution top-down photo of a white quilted paper napkin on a warm-toned tiled surface. On the napkin, draw a crude black marker illustration of five stick figures inside a thick-bordered box, leaving the top and bottom horizontal sections of the box empty for text.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add custom hand-drawn uppercase lettering in black marker style into the top and bottom empty sections of the box, ensuring the ink appears to bleed slightly into the napkin texture.

verificationChecks: Ensure the napkin texture is visible through the ink
Check that the stick figures are simple and 'naive' in style
Verify the border lines are thick and slightly shaky
Confirm the text is centered within its respective boxes

mustRedesign: Specific band names or copyrighted logos
postGenerationChecks: Does the ink look like it was absorbed by the paper?
Are the stick figures appropriately crude?
Is the composition centered and balanced?
Is the text legible but clearly hand-drawn?
recipe.reuseFormula: Create a [SUBJECT] in the style of a [MARKER TYPE] sketch on a [PAPER TEXTURE], framed by [BORDER STYLE] with [TEXT POSITION] hand-lettering.
